remarks: Anchorage at Saugatuck Apartments returns to the market with newly adjusted pricing and only a few luxury residences remaining. Set directly along the picturesque Saugatuck River, this exclusive collection of beautifully reimagined two- and three-bedroom residences offers an exceptional combination of sophisticated design, privacy and an effortless coastal lifestyle. Following an extensive two-year redesign and renovation, each residence features spectacular water views, expansive windows, sophisticated finishes and a private balcony overlooking the river. Beautifully designed interiors embrace the waterfront setting, while the striking contemporary facade, landscaped riverside sitting areas and thoughtfully curated architectural details create a refined sense of understated luxury. Ideally located in the heart of Saugatuck, just moments from downtown Westport, Metro-North, acclaimed restaurants and cafes, shopping, marinas and Westport's beautiful beaches. Available for yearly or two-year lease. With only a few residences remaining, The Anchorage presents a rare opportunity to enjoy the beauty, tranquility and sophistication of direct waterfront living in Westport.
